cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant
cards.description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

cards.name: Radiant Tsareena
cards.description: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.description: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.description: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.description: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Radiant Alakazam
cards.description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.description: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.description: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

cards.name: Radiant Jirachi
cards.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

cards.name: Archen
cards.description: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.description: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

cards.name: Hisuian Braviary
cards.description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
